github.action.logs.get.desc:
Gets a redirect URL to download a plain text file of logs for a workflow job. This link expires after 1 minute. Look
for `Location:` in the response header to find the URL for the download.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
github.action.logs.get.summary: Download job logs for a workflow run

github.action.logs.get1.desc:
Gets a redirect URL to download an archive of log files for a specific workflow run attempt. This link expires after
1 minute. Look for `Location:` in the response header to find the URL for the download.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

github.action.logs.get2.desc:
Gets a redirect URL to download an archive of log files for a workflow run. This link expires after 1 minute. Look for
`Location:` in the response header to find the URL for the download.

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

If the repository is private, OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

github.action.runs.get.desc:
Lists all workflow runs for a repository. You can use parameters to narrow the list of results. For more information about using parameters, see [Parameters](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/getting-started-with-the-rest-api#parameters).

Anyone with read access to the repository can use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint with a private repository.

This endpoint will return up to 1,000 results for each search when using the following parameters: `actor`, `branch`, `check_suite_id`, `created`, `event`, `head_sha`, `status`.
github.action.runs.get.summary: List workflow runs for a repository
